purpose: Feasibility test of asymmetric component-wise temporal source reuse with frozen SmolVLA.
task_selection_basis: Frozen from native SmolVLA baseline success before intervention results were inspected; selected for non-floor/non-ceiling native success.

tasks.task_name: pick up the bbq sauce and place it in the basket
pick up the tomato sauce and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
pick up the black bowl in the top drawer of the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate
put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet
push the plate to the front of the stove
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

semantics.target_time: At environment step t, source query tau supplies target t from chunk index d=t-tau.
semantics.old_gripper_is_not_hold: The retained gripper value is chunk[d,6] from query t-d, not the previous applied command or a constant hold.
semantics.query_policy: Query frozen SmolVLA once at every environment step; compose selected components after native postprocessing.
semantics.warmup: For t<requested_age, use the fresh component because no source query at t-d exists; log actual source age 0 explicitly.

analysis_sampling.offline_state_rule: first ten target steps t>=16 from episode 0 of the fresh query cache
